title: Grapple on shipping pallet
description: Delivered black Loflin grapple on its timber shipping cradle during receiving inspection; physical receipt does not authorize operation.

title: Front grapple construction
description: Front view of the open jaw, lower tines and frame during initial mounting evaluation. Safe locking-pin engagement and operational commissioning remain unverified.

title: Quick-attach locking-pin interface
description: Initial fitment close-up of the quick-attach locking-pin interface. Engagement remains unresolved; both pins must be fully engaged, inspected and corrective action verified before commissioning.
imageAlt: Close-up of ARDHI quick-attach pin and Loflin mounting interface during unresolved fitment review

title: Hydraulic cylinder and hose routing
description: Underside view of the grapple cylinder, hydraulic hoses and couplers during initial mounting inspection. This photograph does not verify hydraulic compatibility, leak-free operation or safe fitment.
imageAlt: Underside of Loflin grapple showing hydraulic cylinder hoses and couplers with red dust caps

title: Manufacturer identification plate and factory pressure-test sticker
description: Actual unit plate: SMPRMINIRG, serial 2459685, manufactured October 22, 2026, width 42 inches, TORODINGO, maximum 3,200 PSI, job 16486-0001-001; weight field blank. The adjacent TESTED 3200 PSI sticker records factory pressure testing, not commissioning or field-test approval.
imageAlt: Loflin serial 2459685 manufacturer plate beside TESTED 3200 psi factory pressure-test sticker

title: Mounting measurements
description: Tape-measure photograph of the rear mounting geometry. Preliminary physical observations only, not certified mounting dimensions or evidence of safe locking-pin engagement.

title: Carrier delivery evidence
description: Existing carrier delivery photograph showing the grapple on a timber cradle and pallet jack beside the liftgate. Retained as delivery history; the photograph alone does not identify the line-haul carrier or authorize operation.
